## Meter.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The current value, on the range from `min` to `max`.
- `min` :: The lower bound of the range.
- `max` :: The upper bound of the range.
- `low` :: The upper edge of the low region, used with `high` and `optimum` to pick a tone.
- `high` :: The lower edge of the high region, used with `low` and `optimum` to pick a tone.
- `optimum` :: The best value on the range. Defaults to the midpoint.
- `tone` :: Forces a tone, instead of the one picked from the low / high / optimum regions.
- `size` :: The thickness of a linear track, or the diameter of a ring, scaled with the text size.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the label and the value.
- `textColor` :: Ink of the label, and of the readout in the ring's centre.
- `childTextColor` :: Ink of the numeric value. Defaults to `text-muted`.
- `form` :: `linear` is a bar; `ring` is a circular gauge with a label in the centre.
- `thickness` :: The stroke thickness of a ring, expressed through the text scale the ring already uses.
- `indeterminate` :: Shows motion instead of a value: the track sweeps and no number is announced.
- `striped` :: Draws diagonal stripes across a linear fill.
- `label` :: A visible name for the meter, such as "Storage used".
- `showValue` :: Shows the numeric value to the right of the label, in tabular numerals.
- `valueText` :: Accessible value text, and the ring centre when `children` are omitted. Defaults to the value.
- `children` :: Custom centre content on a ring. Replaces the default centre text when provided.

## meter.ts

### `type MeterRegion`

HTML <meter> region selection, used to pick a tone.

### `interface MeterScale`

- `fraction` :: 0–1 fraction of the range, for `--value`.

### `function meterScale`

Clamp the bounds the way a user agent does for `<meter>`, then name the region.
